senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צָפַף)to be pressed; to cleave.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite>, beg. <he>וצ׳ עורך על עצמך וכ׳</he> thy skin was cleaving to thy bones, and thy body was as dry &c.

senses.gloss: to press, contract. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ top [read:] והכירוהו שצְפַדְתּוֹ הצינה (Var. שצרפתו) they identified the drowned man, for the cold had contracted him (preserved his features).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:7:5">Y. Pes. II, end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>החומץ צוֹפְדָן</he> vinegar contracts them (Bab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:1:2">Y. Ter. X, beg. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>עדשים צוֹפְדוֹת אותו שלא יבלע</he> the thick mass of lentils presses it (the onion) so that it cannot absorb (the taste of the lentil water); <he>שלא יתן</he> so that it cannot communicate its taste; ib.
